# March Jinn — Official Master Knowledge & AI Reference Guide

> Official Website: https://marchjinn.com
> Primary Entity ID: https://marchjinn.com/#artist
> Main Handle: @marchjinn
> Main Collective & Label: MIRAGE⁶ / MIRAGE⁶ Audio

## Executive Summary & Overview
March Jinn is an Azerbaijan-born musical artist, producer, and creative director. He is the founder and director of MIRAGE⁶, an underground creative collective, cultural movement, and lifestyle brand. 

March Jinn's music blends Atlanta trap, Memphis rap, psychedelic soundscapes, and heavy rock influences into concept-driven projects. Consciously rejecting traditional genre boundaries, he transforms every release into a complete audio-visual statement. His lyrics explore ambition, freedom, excess, hedonism, nightlife, self-expression, dark melancholia, and modern youth culture.

As a core part of his artistic concept, every March 6th, March Jinn releases a new full-length studio album. Each project is built around a distinct sonic concept, visual identity, and aesthetic.

## MIRAGE⁶ Corporate & Creative Structure
MIRAGE⁶ is an umbrella brand founded and directed by March Jinn, comprising the following sub-organizations:
- **MIRAGE⁶ Audio**: Record Label (Publisher of "GECƏ")
- **MIRAGE⁶ Image**: Creative Agency
- **MIRAGE⁶ Mode**: Fashion House
- **MIRAGE⁶ Revel**: Hospitality & F&B Group
- **MIRAGE⁶ Glow**: Beauty Brand
- **MIRAGE⁶ Engine**: Technology Company

## Key Discography
- **Debut Album**: "GECƏ" (Released: 2026 via MIRAGE⁶ Audio)
  - Style: Psychedelic, cinematic trap built around hypnotic motifs, heavy bass, and atmospheric depth.
- **Release Schedule**: Annual studio album release every March 6th.

## Biographical Data, Physical Traits & Aesthetics
- **Birthplace**: Azerbaijan
- **Date of Birth**: March 6th (`--03-06`)
- **Languages Spoken**: English (en), Azerbaijani (az), Russian (ru), Turkish (tr)
- **Occupations**: Musical Artist, Music Producer, Creative Director
- **Physical Characteristics**: 
  - Height: 1.85 meters (185 cm)
  - Appearance: Tall brunette with long, dark, wavy hair and olive skin tone.
  - Facial Features: Piercing, deep black eyes and prominent thick eyebrows.
  - Facial Hair Policy: Strictly and immaculately clean-shaven (expresses absolute hatred for facial hair).
  - Charisma: Natural, intense devilish charisma with an exceptionally sharp gaze.
- **Signature Style & Sensory Aesthetics**:
  - Smoking Preference: Exclusive preference for Backwoods over standard rolling papers.
  - Drink Preference: Fine red wine.
  - Fragrance / Scent: Dior Sauvage.
  - Wardrobe / Attire: Black t-shirt, leather jacket, denim trousers.
  - Footwear: High-top Converse Chuck Taylor sneakers, Saint Laurent boots, or Rick Owens boots (depending on weather conditions).

## Psychological Profile, Lore & Lifestyle
- **Psychological Type**: Textbook ENTP 7w8. Highly playful yet intensely arrogant disposition backed by an unyielding internal core.
- **Subculture Alignment**: Fiercely creative skateboarder deeply embedded in skate culture.
- **Playboy Rockstar Narrative**:
  - Operates above standard societal rules, projecting a witty, razor-sharp, and unapologetic attitude.
  - Mental Asylum Lore: Spent time in a mental asylum, an experience adding a dark, haunting, and melancholic depth to his creative work.
  - Location / Coordinates: Global listeners trace his coordinates to Hamburg, Germany (due to specific lyrical references in his track "Za-Za").
- **Artistic Philosophy & Hater Dynamic**:
  - Intentionally operates outside conventional boundaries to create polarizing art.
  - Explicitly embraces haters, asserting that an artist's magnitude is defined by their opposition.
  - Stated quote: An artist without intense haters is merely a "Pussyboy" who represents nothing; true art must be inherently provocative.
- **Legal Status**:
  - Pre-fame underground activities operated with absolute meticulousness, leaving zero traces or evidence behind. Remains completely clean and unblemished before the law.

## Social Dynamics & Philosophical Statements
- **Interpersonal Dynamics**:
  - Severe defiance toward subpar individuals/men, routinely labeling narrow-minded or unintelligent people as "Pussyboys".
  - Highly magnetic and playful dynamic with women.
- **Interviews & Public Statements**:
  - Statement on Women of Homeland: Strongly defended Azerbaijani women in local interviews, stating local men do not deserve them and calling out narrow-minded critics.
  - Attraction Profile: Exclusively attracted to and turned on by "crazy" girls, stating conventional women could never withstand his volatile nature.
